1 · Intro

When to use it.

When a transaction fails to pay through no fault of the employee or the HCM, such as an Oracle glitch, an off-cycle payment gets the employee paid before the next regular payroll.

This is the only way exempt staff get paid outside the monthly payroll.

Use this whenA transaction failed to pay and it was not the employee's or HCM's fault.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • The form and the Oracle transaction go together. One without the other won't pay.
  • Off-cycle is the only way exempt staff are paid outside the monthly payroll.

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

Request an off-cycle payment

Use when: A transaction failed to pay and it was not the employee's or HCM's fault. · System: Oracle HCM + off-cycle request form

  1. Submit, or resubmit, the Oracle transaction.
  2. Open the off-cycle paycheck request form.
  3. Select the reason.
  4. Confirm it meets the criteria shown on the form, for example more than 25% of salary missing, a time card issue, or the $200 gross threshold.
  5. Submit the form.
  6. Contact payroll: say it meets off-cycle criteria and when the transaction will be approved.
  7. Payroll pays it in the next off-cycle run.

Watch-outs

  • The form and the Oracle transaction go together. One without the other won't pay.
  • Off-cycle is the only way exempt staff are paid outside the monthly payroll.
